## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected? Be concrete — *"I have to manually re-run my evaluation 3 times to get a sense of variance"* is much more useful than *"more flexibility would be nice."*

## Proposed solution

What you'd like Vidimus to do. Sketch the SDK or CLI surface if relevant.

```python
# proposed API
```

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds you've tried or other approaches you considered, and why they fall short.

## Scope check

- [ ] This belongs in Module A (`vidimus.audit`) — provenance, calibration, attestation
- [ ] This belongs in Module B (`vidimus.optimize`) — DRL-based optimization, planned Q3 2026
- [ ] This belongs in Module C (`vidimus.federate`) — federated evaluation, planned 2027
- [ ] This is a new module / out of current scope (motivate why it should be considered anyway)
